name: com.hhmedic.android.sdk.module.browser.HHBrowserAct
description: HH Medics’ doctor SDK opens this screen for its in-app web pages. Pages can request a photo, camera capture or PDF, and the HHVideo release also routes consultation, payment and health-report actions.
disableEffect: Disabling it can interrupt the SDK’s web pages, attachment selection and web-based consultation or payment flows.
